question: In August 2024, who bid farewell to the Supreme Court, became the first woman Chief Justice of the High Court for the State of Telangana and was the ninth woman to be elevated to the Supreme Court of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hima Kohli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Hima Kohli** was appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court of India on 31 August 2021.
 
• She became the first woman Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court on 7 January 2021.
 
• Hima Kohli is the ninth woman to be elevated to the Supreme Court of India.
